StrictModel: Base class used by every API contract.
Rational: Canonical exact rational; floating-point constants are not part of the DSL.
PiExpr: The exact real constant π; never replace it by a decimal approximation.
ConstraintGroup: One conjunction used as a disjunct in a normalized region/query.
BoxSpec: Finite rational box. ``ProblemSpec.analysis_box`` is the working domain X.
RegionSpec:
Shared conjunction plus optional DNF disjuncts.

``bounds`` are part of the mathematical region. Lie and boundary queries use
``ProblemSpec.analysis_box`` as the working domain X.
SourceDomainSpec: Provenance only. Default verification does not read inner_radius.
FixedParameterSpec:
One universally quantified parameter that is constant along a trajectory.

Fixed parameters are not state or control variables.  They may occur in the
vector field, while candidates remain functions of the physical state only.
The literal fields deliberately keep this first interface narrower than the
existing robust, time-varying uncertainty semantics.
IndexedFamilyParameterSpec: The outer dimension parameter of an indexed system family.
IndexedStateFamilySpec: One real-valued coordinate family, such as ``x(i)`` or ``y(i)``.
IndexedBlockDynamicsSpec:
The derivative of one coordinate in the repeated one-index block.

``rhs`` is an exact scalar expression over the local family names.  For a
controlled family it may additionally use the output symbol declared by
``IndexedSharedControllerSpec``.
IndexedSharedControllerSpec: One scalar feedback law reused at every coordinate of the family.
IndexedFamilyDomainSpec: Dimension-polymorphic formal domain for the whole state family.
IndexedFamilyTargetSpec: The dynamical conclusion locked for every positive dimension.
IndexedFamilySpec:
Replayable system contract for Systems 82, 84, and 86.

The contract is authoritative.  It is not a label attached to a frozen
finite-dimensional ``SystemSpec``: the repeated vector field, dimension,
controller sharing, formal domain, and target are all represented here.
ControllerProposal: One concise controller expression returned by the synthesis model.
_CandidateProposalBase: Fields shared by the concise, task-specific synthesis contracts.
CandidateProposal: Legacy broad synthesis contract retained for barrier tasks and replay.
StabilityCandidateProposal: P1 synthesis contract: the claimed domain is fixed, so there is no level_c.
RoaCandidateProposal: P2 synthesis contract: Omega_c is candidate-defined, so level_c is required.
QuerySpec: Existential counterexample query; verification expects UNSAT.
VerificationRouterDecision:
One Agent decision for one condition.

The Agent chooses the verification backend and, when SMT is selected,
supplies a complete ordering of the eligible solver backends.
LeanLocalPatch: One constrained edit for a framework-selected Lean source span.
CertificationLevel:
Legacy combined label retained for verdict-v1 compatibility.

New consumers should read `CandidateVerdict.scope` and
`CandidateVerdict.backend_profile` as two independent dimensions.
